a.lede: California enacts new laws aimed at companies using AI to initiate job cuts or monitor employees.
a.title: California's new law bans companies from relying on AI to fire workers

b.lede: After lawyers were fined for submitting AI filings packed with fictitious case law, AI companies are releasing new tools to ensure that doesn't happen again.
b.title: The AI industry wants models to assist in legal battles, but will they help?
